title: Make a tiny sound map
description: Listen to birds, wind and distant city sounds. A quiet listening break outside, without walking.
steps: Choose a familiar outdoor seat or doorstep.
Put your phone away and listen for three different sounds.
Point toward the nearest and the farthest sound. Return when you are ready.

title: Find five colors
description: A playful color scavenger hunt outdoors for children, families and curious people. Find colorful flowers and leaves.
steps: Pick five colors before leaving.
On a familiar short path, find one example of each color.
Leave everything where it is. Bring back one color you had overlooked.

title: Take a familiar brisk loop
description: Get some exercise, stretch your legs and move your body with an energetic walk around a familiar neighborhood loop.
steps: Choose a familiar route you can return from easily.
Walk at a comfortable energetic pace for five minutes, then turn back.
Use the last two minutes to slow down and notice one thing nearby.

title: Watch one cloud change
description: Sit outside and watch clouds move across the sky. A calm break for tired people who want to rest without walking.
steps: Find a comfortable outdoor seat with an open view of the sky.
Pick one cloud and watch how its edge changes.
Remember its first and last shapes. No photo needed.

title: Study a leaf without picking it
description: Explore botany, plants, leaves and nature. Look closely at the veins, textures and edges of a nearby leaf.
steps: Choose an accessible plant outdoors.
Look for three details: the edge, the vein pattern and the surface.
Compare it with another leaf. Leave both on the plant.

title: Sketch a shadow
description: Draw, sketch or make outdoor art. Study the shapes and lines of a shadow using a pencil and paper.
steps: Take a scrap of paper and a pencil outside.
Sketch the outline of a tree or railing shadow.
Add one detail from the scene, then return with your small drawing.

title: Watch one bird from a distance
description: Birdwatching for beginners. Observe a bird, its movement and behavior without identifying species or disturbing wildlife.
steps: Sit somewhere you have previously seen birds.
Watch one bird from a respectful distance for two minutes.
Remember three actions it made. Do not feed or approach it.

title: Invite a friend on a short loop
description: Spend time with a friend, partner or neighbor. A social walk and conversation outdoors without scrolling.
steps: Invite someone who is already available.
Take a familiar short loop together with phones in pockets.
Each share one thing you noticed today. Turn back halfway.
